findings: Current source lines 17–21 preserve the three branches and the Checkout mode/currency limits, but frame manual `payment_method_types` as the entire Checkout path. The dated May guide offers dynamic payment methods as well. With manual configuration, include `mb_way` and use EUR for every line item. Hosted and full embedded Checkout use a Checkout Session and the examples show `success_url` versus `return_url` plus `ui_mode: embedded_page` respectively (old raw lines 14–51 and 53–108). Add the dynamic/manual distinction for readers selecting an integration.

Current source lines 13 and 21 make the web Elements beta flag sound current and omit the Payment Element’s client confirmation path, while lines 13 and 23 call out the similarly named Direct API branch. In May, the server creates an EUR PaymentIntent with amount and `mb_way`; the browser uses its client secret with `stripe.confirmPayment` for the Payment Element or `stripe.confirmMbWayPayment` for the historical Direct API branch, with `payment_method.billing_details.phone` in the new-PaymentMethod example. The client secret is for the relevant customer and should not be logged or placed in URLs (old raw lines 149–167, 248–287, 390–432, 567–585 and 654–683).

Current source lines 23–34 need a payment state/fulfillment boundary. Confirmation initiates the app authorization and the buyer can approve or decline. Default Direct API polling waits for `succeeded` or a failure return to `requires_payment_method`. With `handleActions: false`, use the PaymentIntents API to retrieve status. Use the dated payment success event/Checkout fulfillment route for business actions instead of the browser return, presentment alone, or mere request acceptance. The four sandbox errors return to `requires_payment_method`. Identify the examples as sandbox even under the nearby 'any other' row (old raw lines 106–129, 532–548, 654–720).

Separate changelogs specify that Checkout Session create and PaymentIntent create on 2026-09-30.endive return HTTP 400 for writable payment_method_types, with payment_method_types_no_longer_supported documented for the Intent endpoint. Use Dashboard-managed dynamic methods or allowed_payment_method_types to supply a compatibility-filtered list. The computed payment_method_types remains a response property. contributions.original_prompts:
New raw: `raw/stripe-payments-mb-way-accept-a-payment-2026-11-07.md`. Prior raw: `raw/stripe-mb-way-accept-payment-2025.md`. Current summaries: `wiki/sources/source-stripe-mb-way-accept-payment.md`.

- Q1: For `https://docs.stripe.com/payments/mb-way/accept-a-payment`, what central documented behavior, prerequisites, identities and state boundaries does the complete new capture establish, and how does it compare with the matched old capture and every mapped current summary?

- Q2: Which changes are substantive versus presentational or navigation-only? Which historical claims must remain dated, which conflicts need reciprocal warnings, and which API, UI, version, client/server or outcome qualifications prevent unsupported inferences?

reviewed_answers.Q1: At https://docs.stripe.com/payments/mb-way/accept-a-payment, new raw lines 5-15 identify MB WAY acceptance and route readers to Checkout, Elements and Direct API. The May 7 acceptance guide lists Checkout merchant business locations as Europe, US, CA, NZ, SG, HK, JP, AU and MX, and assumes an existing Checkout integration. The Checkout Session uses payment mode and EUR for all line-item Prices. Dynamic method selection and the historical manual mb_way request are separate routes (old raw lines 14-51). The May overview lists Portugal as customer location, while the acceptance guide supports international phone numbers. The phone links to the buyer's MB WAY app, where the buyer approves or declines (old raw lines 8-12, raw/stripe-mb-way-2025.md:14-22). The dated Elements and Direct API examples start from a server-created EUR PaymentIntent and hand off its client secret. The May web Payment Element uses the beta flag and stripe.confirmPayment. The May Direct API new-PaymentMethod example passes the phone in billing details to browser-side stripe.confirmMbWayPayment. A separate November Stripe.js reference also supports an existing PaymentMethod ID or no additional data when a PaymentMethod is already attached (raw/stripe-js-payment-intents-confirm-mb-way-payment-2026-11-07.md:7-15,21-45,53-66). Default Direct API polling follows the Intent to succeeded or a failure return to requires_payment_method, with manual retrieval available when handleActions is false. For business actions use the server-side payment success event or Checkout fulfillment route (old raw lines 106-125, old raw lines 149-167, old raw lines 248-267, old raw lines 390-432, old raw lines 567-585, old raw lines 654-720). source-stripe-mb-way-accept-payment.md lines 13–34 capture the headline paths and cases but omit these eligibility, request-version, PaymentMethod input and authorization qualifications and the explicit sandbox qualifier.
reviewed_answers.Q2: At https://docs.stripe.com/payments/mb-way/accept-a-payment, new raw lines 5-15 replace the inline guide with three navigation links. Preserve the May 7 capture for the historical Checkout and browser confirmation flows, including the scoped web Payment Element beta examples and the sandbox phones. The May manual Checkout and EUR PaymentIntent examples pass payment_method_types in requests (old raw lines 44-51, old raw lines 149-167, old raw lines 567-585). Separate changelogs identify Checkout Session create and PaymentIntent create on 2026-09-30.endive as rejecting that writable request field with HTTP 400. They describe Dashboard-managed dynamic methods and allowed_payment_method_types, with compatibility filtering. The computed payment_method_types remains readable in responses. Scope the claim to the linked Endive endpoints and REST table because the Intent changelog's Impact line 28 uses the inconsistent 2026-08-26.preview label (raw/stripe-changelog-endive-2026-09-30-remove-payment-method-types-checkout-sessions-2026-11-07.md:5-23 and raw/stripe-changelog-endive-2026-09-30-removes-the-payment-method-types-parameter-from-payment-intents-and-setup-intents-2026-11-07.md:5-24,28,34-36). Put the version warning beside the May examples in source-stripe-mb-way-accept-payment.md and on its reciprocal Wallets route. The separate November method overview gives four minutes for customer approval, with the merchant page remaining open and polling, no MB WAY browser redirect or method-level return URL, and settlement on the standard payout schedule (raw/stripe-payments-mb-way-2026-11-07.md:9-16,149-171). Qualify the concept's immediate confirmation wording accordingly. Keep the May hosted success_url and embedded return_url as Checkout Session example settings (old raw lines 53-104). The May new-PaymentMethod phone input and default/manual polling are distinct from the November Stripe.js existing/attached PaymentMethod confirmation paths (raw/stripe-js-payment-intents-confirm-mb-way-payment-2026-11-07.md:7-15,21-45,53-66, old raw lines 654-720). Sandbox timing, a confirmation request and a return to the page cannot establish live approval, payment success or funds availability.
